name: Focus Punch
description: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Power is multiplied by 1.2 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Iron Fist.
Cannot be selected by Me First.
Cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
